repository.name: leakcanary

issue.body:
A common source of confusion is whether LeakCanary is currently activated / working (e.g. #1803)

I think we could add that information to the 3rd (info) tab of LeakCanary. Something tthat shows whether object tracking & heap dumping are turned on, and maybe even with a string explaining why the value is set (e.g. "build is non debuggable", "tests detected", "config changed via code")

body:
The logs you shared show this: `LeakCanary.Config.dumpHeap is false`

That means that LeakCanary is disabled. There should be logs indicating whether LeakCanary is enabled or not.

Can you provide the logcat from the app start? LeakCanary should output more logs on app start indicating why it's turning off heap dumping.
